the two inserts have SEPARATE refusal sets: a 23514 on the CLAIM row is a caller bug that must be reported, and a claim-path code on the SCOPE insert is a fault that must not be absorbed as a conflict
a POSIX errno like EPIPE is five uppercase letters on the same field, and no SQLSTATE begins with E, so the shape alone is not enough to call the value a SQLSTATE
the private pool carries the SQLSTATE on sqlState and sets code to the class of failure, so reading only code matches no guarded refusal at all
